verdict.rationale: One hands-on community report says a user built an internal app with auth and roles using v0, and the docs say v0 scaffolds full-stack apps. That suggests the builder can generate authentication, but the docs never describe sign-up or login scaffolding. The Supabase backend-services integration is related but is never documented as providing auth. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of auth scaffolding, explicit email sign-up/login flows, social provider (OAuth) support, and independent corroboration beyond a single anecdote.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add user sign-up and login (email, social providers) scaffolded by the builder

citations.quote: Built a feature-rich internal app (time tracker w/ auth, roles, export) and had a working MVP in users' hands by Monday.
Quickly scaffold full-stack apps or components following best practices and modern standards.
